rules.label: Student visa through the German Mission in India: a blocked account with at least 11,904 EUR for the first year of studies (the page also requires a blocking confirmation of no more than 992 EUR per month, which is not checked)

citations.quote: Blocked bank account (“Sperrkonto”) in Germany with sufficient funds to cover the first year of studies, currently amounting to 11,904.—EUR and with a blocking confirmation stating that no more than 992.—EUR per month can be withdrawn.
The blocked account must have sufficient credit in order to cover the costs of daily life in Germany (unless other proof of financial support is presented in addition).
